crossMirror.comparison: Identical content after CRLF/LF folding; bundled snapshot unchanged CRLF.

license.annotations: GNU General Public License (version unspecified in dataset header), plus verbatim/no-changing notice
license.underlyingText: Tanzil Uthmani v1.0.2; CC BY-ND 3.0 Unported, plus verbatim/no-changing notice
license.scope: Separate third-party data; no relicensing of generic SDK code.

alignment.method: Equal per-ayah word count AND each mapped word surface matches after alignment-key folding
folds: remove Unicode Mn and Me combining characters
replace U+0671 alef wasla with U+0627 alef
alignment.failedWords: No features assigned; source word coordinates and reason retained.
alignment.limitation: Surface equality is an alignment check, not an independent validation of QAC annotation accuracy.

projection.person: Exact QAC flags 1/2/3 with number, only if segment values agree
projection.number: QAC S/D/P flags; only if segment values agree
projection.aspect: Original PERF/IMPF tags retained; no past/future semantic inference
projection.mood: Original imperative tag IMPV retained separately from aspect
projection.rootLemma: Buckwalter strings decoded to Arabic, no linguistic changes
projection.conflicts: Omit conflicting aggregate field and retain every segmentFeatures value plus ambiguousFields

compactSchema.evidenceReconstruction: Each tuple is a derived QAC tag projection, method qac-tag-projection-v1, sourceId from its enclosing record. Full segment conflict/evidence details live in quran.morphology.json; raw source and all notices are unchanged in data/upstream.
